description: This file defines the Fisher class which provides statistical functions related to the Fisher distribution, including the Fisher transformation and its inverse. It is used for hypothesis testing and correlation analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Fisher
classes.description: Provides static methods for Fisher distribution transformations, including the Fisher transformation and its inverse, primarily used in statistical hypothesis testing and correlation analysis within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the Fisher transformation at a given value, producing a normally distributed value for hypothesis testing on correlation coefficients.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the Fisher transformation, useful for analyzing correlations between data ranges or arrays.
